entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order... I bought this Aero Race jersey, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order was... 774-29B-103. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I usually love everything. This is the first time I've had a problem.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 48 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not damaged or anything. It's just the wrong size. I waited so long to buy it, and when I finally tried it on for a ride, it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I feel terrible about it.
I see. So the fit isn't right for you. I understand how frustrating that can be.
It is. I was hoping I could possibly do an exchange for a bigger size, or maybe just a return? I really needed this money for some other gear if this jersey wasn't going to work out.
Of course. Let me just double-check our current return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, Sarah, I have good news. Looking at our policy for this item, you are still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long and would be stuck with it. Thank you so much.

It's no problem at all. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated that return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
That's perfect. You have no idea how much that helps. I really appreciate it, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so understanding.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
